description: Single pressable toggle button built on Radix UI Toggle, supporting default and outline variants with three sizes. Uses secondary token for active (pressed) state background.
useCases: Text formatting button (bold, italic, underline) in a rich text editor
Single filter toggle for active/inactive state in a toolbar
View mode toggle (list vs. grid) as a standalone button
Mute/unmute or pin/unpin action button with visual pressed state
